purpose: Distinguish native Windows OpenCode, the AgentSwitchboard WSL shim, and WSL Ubuntu OpenCode runtime identity without mutating workstation state or duplicating current launcher ownership.

knownRuntimeSurfaces.role: AgentSwitchboard command shim delegating to WSL Ubuntu
declared adapter state; evidence only until compared with effective launch identity

commands.name: Observed current-process status
commands.proof: current parent PowerShell resolution and known local-path observations only

commands.name: Focused validator
commands.proof: leaf components, registry/workflow/fixture semantics, provenance boundary, and reporter contract

commands.name: Semantic contracts
commands.proof: synthetic runtime classification and salvage-boundary semantics

knownTraps: opencode debug config proves resolved configuration, not which executable a later child process spawns.
Get-Command opencode in the parent PowerShell proves only parent process resolution.
AgentSwitchboard can expose both a native Windows npm OpenCode and a Windows opencode.cmd shim that delegates to WSL Ubuntu.
A healthy WSL OpenCode installation does not prove a native Windows OpenCode launch is using the intended executable.
A state.json commandPath is declared adapter state, not effective child-process proof.
uv or uv_spawn failures must be attributed to the exact failing process and environment rather than inferred from an unrelated parent-shell uv command.
Harness-only diagnosis never edits PATH, removes shims, reinstalls OpenCode, or changes launcher product code.

mergeIntoCurrentOwners: source-authority references point at current technician/GNHF/OpenCode owners
live completion remains owned by existing end-to-end runtime validation

salvage.reason: Preserve unique executable-provenance diagnostics without replaying stale shared routing or creating a second OpenCode lifecycle owner.

proofCeiling: Tracked leaf contracts, deterministic synthetic collision classification, and read-only repository/current-process observation only; exact child identity requires exact-chain runtime evidence.
